page_lead: For patients from the five Central Asian countries and across Xinjiang, we provide care navigation in Chinese, Russian, and Uzbek.

cross_border.title: Cross-border care · From Almaty, Tashkent, Bishkek to Urumqi
cross_border.lead: Visas, medical escorts, lodging, translators, and follow-up after discharge. The Xinjiang flagship team arranges it in advance.

visa.title: Visa and invitation letter
visa.body: We issue medical invitation letters and coordinate medical visa procedures for Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, and Kyrgyzstan.

translator.title: Three-language escort
translator.body: Chinese, Russian, and Uzbek translators accompany you through outpatient visits, tests, and surgical conversations.

hotel.title: Lodging and transfers
hotel.body: A curated list of partner lodgings near the hospital for accompanying family, plus scheduled airport and hospital transfers.

followup.title: Follow-up after discharge
followup.body: Once you are back in Central Asia, you can keep seeing the same physician by video for condition updates and medication changes.

uigur.title: Uyghur medicine clinic
uigur.lead: Uyghur medicine is on China's national intangible cultural heritage list. It is well suited to chronic digestion, skin, and seasonal conditions.

kazakh.title: Kazakh medicine clinic
kazakh.lead: Kazakh traditional medicine combines herbal formulas, mineral springs, and herbal baths, paired with modern medicine for sub-health conditioning.
